items.title: *The Week in 15 Selections*
items.content:
Hello and welcome back to the week in links!The weather has been perfect in the northeast for almost two weeks, and I’m in the best mood. I spent all of last week in New York City recording something secret and so fun. I had the best time. I saw many of my dear friends, visited two dog parks, and my hotel had dimmers on every single light, which felt like a rare blessing.

The first few recommendations this week, as perhaps expected, are NYC based. But then there are plenty of regular links beneath that. Do not fear.

I hope everyone had a Happy Halloweekend! On to the links:

  1. More fish stuff I’m not allowed to buy! Friend of the newsletter (me) Josh Gondleman sent me these ADORABLE fish night-lights from Millers Art Glass.

 The choices you have are to simply lie to your child about what is happening right up until the moment a needle presents itself, or try to reason with them about the benefits of not getting sick (or getting everyone else in the family, at school, or in the neighborhood sick). There is also bribery. No matter the choice, you know with absolute certainty it will all dissolve into the most devastating sobs and accusatory stares, and you will be haunted by your child's primal screams and their burgeoning taste for vengeance
